scope: Targeted primary-source review of evidence correction, support, regeneration and agent actions; not a systematic review or novelty certification.

source_policy.versioned_papers: Specific inspected versions recorded; reported results not independently reproduced.
source_policy.affiliations: Paper-time author lines only, not current employment or inferred research groups.
source_policy.unknowns: Null dates, affiliations and artifacts are deliberate; unavailable sources are not silently treated as read.
source_policy.software: Mutable public specifications are prior art but not equivalent to peer-reviewed performance evidence.

search_passes.note: Aggregator hits used only for discovery; primary paper URLs inspected.

references.title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs

citation.venue: Preprint; manuscript names Who Verifies the Agents? workshop

read_depth.notes: Methods, oracle objective, summary receipts and limitations read; not independently reproduced.

references.closest_claim: Regeneration after withdrawal is not the same objective as surviving-source support.
references.overlap: Alternative support bundles, sentence receipts and selective cleanup are existing methods.
references.limitations: The paper explicitly measures constructor-relative liveness; source-groundedness remains ungraded.
references.what_we_borrow: Reproduce or label adaptation of its audit; compare with independent support labels.
references.discriminating_test: Does audit disagreement change decisions under the same evidence policy?
source_quality_notes: Paper-linked repository returned 404 during this review; that does not prove permanent unavailability.

references.title: Stored Is Not Supported: Typed Provenance and Assertion Guardrails for Persistent AI Agents
references.closest_claim: Report, belief, support, truth, validity and release authority require different judgments.
references.overlap: Preserved history, alternative support, revocation and typed release are direct conceptual predecessors.
references.limitations: Reported conformance is structured; natural-language extraction and general graph traversal are not implemented.
references.what_we_borrow: Operationalize existing semantics and evaluate the extraction assumption.
references.discriminating_test: Does a model-extracted representation improve beyond ordinary grounding?
source_quality_notes: Future end-to-end evaluation is proposed in Appendix C, so its need is also prior art.

references.title: When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not: Repairing Implicit Stale Dependencies in Personalized Agent Responses
references.closest_claim: Updated stored state need not update implicit response dependencies.

references.limitations: Provenance/chronology gates do not establish semantic supersession; difficult transfer has no gain.
references.what_we_borrow: Separate transition extraction from gate correctness and downstream behavior.
references.discriminating_test: Measure report/endorsement extraction with matched evidence and calls.

references.title: Structure Before Intelligence: Gating What Agentic Scientific Workflows Release
references.closest_claim: Execution completion does not authorize release; validation and lineage affect release/retraction.
references.overlap: Explicit release manifests, recovery and late-evidence consequences are evaluated.
references.limitations: Two designed workflows; validator/fault co-design; no measurable agent benefit is shown.
references.what_we_borrow: Count release versions, collateral withholding and validation cost separately.
references.discriminating_test: Does linguistic interpretation add value beyond a deterministic harness?

references.title: GSAR: Typed Grounding for Hallucination Detection and Recovery in Multi-Agent LLMs
references.closest_claim: Typed evidence grounding can select proceeding, regeneration or replanning.
references.overlap: Grounding-to-recovery control is already an evaluated approach.
references.limitations: Atomicity and expert weights are assumptions; forged tool outputs and provenance defense are outside scope.

references.discriminating_test: Test scope/validity changes at fixed policy rather than invent a new grounding score.
